subject: Placeholder rule and the car as an unmarked SUV; Addendum B; take 2 released

attachments.description: Addendum B: the car as an unmarked SUV (writer's assumption on Ziggy's direction); sixteen-still take 2; supersedes Addendum A section 2
interview file: S carries the assumption; S-f1 becomes a review of the stills; also carries the placeholder rule (5e) from earlier tonight
decisions record with sections 5e (placeholder rule) and 5f (the car) appended

body: Two of Ziggy's decisions tonight. (1) The placeholder rule, refining the rating decision: a scene the tools refuse or that is hard to make well now gets a labelled placeholder that holds its place on the board; nothing is shied away from, rewritten or cut; the real make comes when the effort is worth it (decisions 5e). (2) The car: do not wait on the author; assume a present-day unmarked SUV, near-black and plain, passing as a private car; he reviews the stills and we itemize what differs. Addendum B carries the identity and lifts the car take 2 as sixteen stills; Addendum A section 2 is superseded; take 1 stands (decisions 5f). The go is posted in the Pent House. Provider-facing prose now says 'a dark unmarked SUV'.
